description: This magnificent four-star apartment is ideally located in the center of Paris, in the heart of the 3rd arrondissement, on Boulevard de Sébastopol. Whether you are on a business trip or visiting our beautiful capital, we offer you the opportunity to live like a Parisian during your stay, while enjoying the services of a luxury residence.The spaceThis fully air-conditioned/heated apartment features 3 bedrooms with Queen-size beds, two bathrooms, two living rooms with a flat-screen TV equipped with Chromecast, and a fully equipped kitchen, including a Nespresso coffee machine.Luxury toiletries, high-quality towels and linens, as well as numerous complimentary amenities, are provided for your comfort, making you feel at home.Please note that AC / heating is central : heating from October to April and AC during summer, depending on the weather in Paris.Guest accessYou can easily access your accommodation using public transportation: Réaumur station on line 3 and line 4.Other things to noteA code will be provided to you before your arrival to access your apartment autonomously and securely.
